text:
Silver Price in 2003
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2003, the LBMA silver price rose 22.4% between 2003-01-31 ($4.87) and 2003-12-31 ($5.97). The highest sampled price was $5.97 in December and the lowest was $4.46 in March. The mean of these observations was $4.95. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
